# 3D Print Shop Software

> Vendor-neutral resource for commercial 3D print shop operators evaluating and managing software stacks. Covers printer control, fleet management, job economics, inventory, and customer management tools.

## Core

- [Home](https://3dprintshopsoftware.com/)
- [Why Software Matters](https://3dprintshopsoftware.com/why/)
- [Software Landscape](https://3dprintshopsoftware.com/landscape/)
